# Audio { #anylumino.Audio }

```python
Audio(
    value=b'',
    format='mp3',
    layout=None,
)
```

Audio display widget.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type     | Description                                              | Default    |
|--------|----------|----------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `b''` |
| format | optional | Media format such as ``'png'``, ``'mp3'``, or ``'mp4'``. | `'mp3'` |
| layout | optional | ipywidgets ``Layout`` object for CSS sizing and spacing. | `None` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [autoplay](#anylumino.Audio.autoplay) | When true, the audio starts when it's displayed |
| [controls](#anylumino.Audio.controls) | Specifies that audio controls should be displayed (such as a play/pause button etc) |
| [format](#anylumino.Audio.format) | The format of the audio. |
| [loop](#anylumino.Audio.loop) | When true, the audio will start from the beginning after finishing |
